EN: nun passage made literal (was silently corrected in body); [i.e. the sila] put in translator note.
TR: silently corrected نائب الفعل to nâib-i fâil; added Mütercim notu

p2.note: Source is garbled by typesetting: the headings (إنما أموالكم وأولادكم فتنة) and (والله عنده أجر عظيم) are fused into the preceding text (وخبراهاِنَّما / خبرَ اللَّهُ); content otherwise complete and both readings restore it with a marked note.
